## demo greet

### demo greet

Greet someone

#### Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | `string` | yes | Name to greet |

#### Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--loud` | `boolean` | `false` | Shout |
| `--times` | `number` | `1` | Repeat count |
| `--style` | `string` |  | Style |
| `--old` | `string` |  | **Deprecated.** Old flag |
| `--tag` | `array` |  | Tags |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `message` | `string` | yes |  |

#### Examples

```sh
# Greet the world
demo greet world

demo greet bob --loud true
```

> Names are case-sensitive.

## demo users

Manage users

### demo users delete

Delete a user

#### Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | yes |  |

> Confirm with the user before executing this destructive command.

### demo users get

Get a user

#### Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | yes | User ID |

### demo users list

List users

#### Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--limit` | `number` | `10` | Max users |

#### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `users` | `array` | yes |  |
| `users[].id` | `number` | yes |  |
| `users[].name` | `string` | yes |  |
